text:
Situation: Omeprazole 20 mg capsules are low at Corvale East with 36 on hand (4.2 days). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 494 capsules (273 at 27.6 days and 221 at 24.1 days). The rule‑ranked option is to transfer 85 capsules from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving the sender with about two weeks' supply and bringing the receiver to 14 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show omeprazole is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. One Corvale General source is labeled by Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028), most recent FDA inspection classified VAI on 2022-12-08. The other source is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), most recent FDA inspection classified VAI on 2026-07-16. Alternate manufacturers Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., and Apotex Corp are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new purchasing risk. External purchases remain available but carry supply‑chain uncertainty because plant locations are unverified.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 85 capsules of omeprazole 20 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place purchase order with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC if transfer cannot meet need — requires buyer approval.
3. Place purchase order with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC if needed — requires buyer approval.
4. Place purchase order with Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. if needed — requires buyer approval.
5. Place purchase order with Apotex Corp if needed — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting external orders; Corvale East will exhaust stock in 4.2 days.
